symbols.name: input length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two input integers.
symbols.quote: Let $n$ be the number of bits in each of the two input integers.

symbols.name: fixed machine
symbols.meaning: A fixed multiplication machine, whose alphabet and tape count do not depend on the input.
symbols.quote: Let $T_A(n)$ be the running time of a machine $A$ on inputs of that length.

symbols.name: running time
symbols.meaning: The worst-case running time of machine A as a function of the input length n.
symbols.quote: Let $T_A(n)$ be the running time of a machine $A$ on inputs of that length.

symbols.name: lower-bound constant
symbols.meaning: A positive constant, depending on machine A, in the eventual lower bound T_A(n) >= c_A n log n.
symbols.quote: that for each machine $A$ there are constants $c_A > 0$ and $N_A$ such that $T_A(n) \geq c_A\, n \log n$ for all $n \geq N_A$.

symbols.name: threshold input length
symbols.meaning: The input length from which the lower bound for machine A holds.
symbols.quote: that for each machine $A$ there are constants $c_A > 0$ and $N_A$ such that $T_A(n) \geq c_A\, n \log n$ for all $n \geq N_A$.
